Multi-output ridge regression (scikit-learn Ridge, penalty 1.0 fixed before any result, intercept, unscaled features). Features: the 1,024-bit fingerprint, a one-hot cell-line indicator and their products (4,099 features on sci-Plex, 15,374 on Tahoe-100M). Target: the mean expression change of a condition from its matched vehicle cells. Fitted on the training conditions.
The same regression, fitted within the held-out compounds by five-fold cross-validation with folds grouped by structure.
One shift per cell line: the mean change over the held-out conditions of that line.
The shift is added to the matched vehicle cells and negative values are set to zero; one shifted cell per measured cell, at most 200 per condition.
